patient_text: If you already drink grapefruit juice every day, you can keep drinking it. Do not start drinking grapefruit juice while you are taking Atorvastatin. Grapefruit juice raises the amount of Atorvastatin in your blood, which raises your risk of muscle pain and muscle damage. Tell your pharmacist how much grapefruit juice you drink and how often. Ask your pharmacist for more information.
questions: I drink grapefruit juice about ___ times a week. Is that amount a problem with my {ING}?|Does this apply to whole grapefruit and other citrus, or only the juice?|What kind of muscle pain should make me call you?

patient_text: Take your Levothyroxine on an empty stomach. It is best to take it first thing in the morning, or at bedtime 3 to 4 hours after your last meal. Food lowers how much of the thyroid hormone your body absorbs. Ask your pharmacist for more information.
questions: How long after my {ING} can I eat breakfast?|Does coffee count as food for this?

patient_text: Separate your Doxycycline from dairy products like milk, yogurt, and cheese by at least 2 hours. The calcium in dairy blocks your body from absorbing the medicine. Ask your pharmacist for more information.
questions: Can I take my {ING} with food if it upsets my stomach, as long as it is not dairy?|Does this include milk in coffee?

patient_text: You do not need to stop eating leafy greens like spinach or kale while taking Warfarin. What matters is keeping the amount the same from week to week, because large changes can affect how well your Warfarin works. Tell your pharmacist if your diet changes a lot.
questions: I eat salad about ___ times a week. Is that steady enough for my {ING}?|Should I tell you before I start a new diet?

patient_text: Limit alcohol while taking Metformin. Drinking heavily raises the risk of a rare but serious problem called lactic acidosis, and it can also cause low blood sugar. Ask your pharmacist for more information.
questions: How many drinks a week is reasonable while I am on {ING}?|What symptoms of low blood sugar should I watch for after drinking?
